notes:
Short CRM notes / call snippets:
- Product/CTO: Maya Chen; Platform lead: Aaron Holt.
- Primary pain: current in-house embeddings + search costs high; support volume spiky -> need predictable capacity.
- Latency targets: p50 <= 200ms, p95 <= 550ms for user-facing assistant; throughput target ~40-60 RPS steady-state; peak bursting to 150 RPS acceptable with burst capacity.
- Cost sensitivity: wants to keep annual inference spend < $150k if possible, open to reserved commit for Dedicated.
- Model preferences: prefer curated open models; want 2-tier model strategy: high-quality 13B for premium customers + quantized 7B for fallback/bulk.
- Routing/fallback: plan to route by customer tier -> premium -> primary region/model, default -> cheaper quantized variant; region failover US->EU if US capacity degraded.
- "Canary" approach agreed: 2-week canary within POC (10% traffic -> 30% -> 100% if metrics OK). Canary metrics: error rate < 1.5%, latency p95 < 650ms, output quality (BLEU/qual eval) delta < 3% vs baseline.
- Rollback criteria: sustained error rate > 3% for 5m OR p95 > 750ms for 5m OR regression in eval prompts > 5% -> immediate rollback to previous model variant + notify via Pager/Slack.
- Observability: request detailed token-level cost + per-route latency traces. Priya to configure Redwood Console dashboards during POC.
- Compliance: need audit logs retention 7 years (legal asked) and EU residency for subset of logs.
- Customer quote: "If we can control unit costs and guarantee latency, we'll consolidate two of our existing endpoints."
- Pricing convo: AE sent committed capacity pricing + reserved tier discount (drive link). Customer asked about NRE for VPC peering and dedicated onboarding.
poc_plan:
Dedicated POC (3 weeks) - high level:
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): legal & network clearances; KMS provisioning; sample data scrubbed; egress rules defined.
- Week 1: infra deploy in customer VPC (dedicated GPU pool), baseline tests w/ small model variant; integrate SSO and audit logging. SE (Priya) to run smoke tests.
- Week 2: Canary (10% traffic) -> collect metrics for 48h -> expand to 30% if OK. Test model variants: open-13b-quant (primary) vs open-7b-8q (fallback). Implement KV prefix caching for repeat query patterns.
- Week 3: Scale to target throughput (50 RPS); run quality evals on 2k prompt set; run region failover test (simulate US capacity drop -> route to EU).
- Success criteria: p50 <=200ms, p95 <=550-650ms (depending on prompt length), error rate <1.5%, cost per 1k tokens within forecasted threshold.
- Deliverables: POC runbook, performance report, cost projection, canary config export (JSON) and rollback playbook.
